title: Distributed Antitrust Common-Ownership, Fiduciary, and Cloud-Subpoena Liquidation Bundle
description: Locked constant and output validation surface for SPEC-DISTRIBUTED-ANTITRUST-COMMON-OWNERSHIP-AND-FIDUCIARY-LIQUIDATION-v1.0. Covers the MHHI common-ownership presumption gate, ERISA fiduciary loss and exact fee disgorgement, housing-cartel and wage-suppression treble overcharges, the FRCP 37(e)(2) cloud-metadata spoliation inference, distributed-enforcement joint-capture arithmetic, and the combined cartel-liquidation identity.

antitrust_common_ownership.description: Common-ownership MHHI gate. Identities: HHI_Base = 10000/N; Delta_HHI_CO = lambda_CO * 10000 * (N - 1) / N; MHHI_Total = HHI_Base + Delta_HHI_CO; Multiple = Delta_HHI_CO / DOJ_Delta_HHI_Threshold.

N_Competitors_Coal.description: Number of competitors in the common-ownership coalition.

HHI_Base_Pts.description: Baseline Herfindahl-Hirschman Index in points; equals the equal-share anchor 10000/N.

beta_Big3_Combined_Share.description: Combined equity share of the three largest coalition members; bounds the internalization coupling.

Delta_HHI_CO_Pts.description: HHI increment induced by common-ownership internalization (points).

DOJ_HHI_Threshold_Pts.description: DOJ/FTC highly concentrated market HHI threshold (points).

Multiple_Above_DOJ_Delta_Limit.description: Factor by which Delta_HHI_CO exceeds the DOJ delta threshold.

erisa_fiduciary.description: ERISA fiduciary block. Identities: L_plan = A * Delta_r * T; D_fee = A * phi * T; L_single = L_plan + D_fee; L_systemic = L_single * N_plans. Conflict predicate: Rank_Equity <= 5 with debt exposure > 0.

D_Corp_BlackRock_Debt_USD.description: Corporate debt exposure creating the creditor-versus-equity conflict (USD).

Rank_Equity_BlackRock.description: Equity-holder rank; satisfies the top-5 conflict-standing predicate.

phi_Management_Fee.description: Annual management-fee rate subject to disgorgement (fraction, 15 bps).

L_ERISA_Plan_Loss_USD.description: Single-plan fiduciary loss A * Delta_r * T (USD).

D_ERISA_Fee_Disgorgement_Exact_USD.description: Exact fee disgorgement A * phi * T (USD).

L_ERISA_Total_Single_Plan_USD.description: Single-plan total liability, loss plus disgorgement (USD).

N_S_and_P_Plans_Exposed.description: Number of exposed comparable single-employer plans.

L_ERISA_Systemic_100Plans_USD.description: Systemic exposure across all exposed plans (USD).

housing_cartel.description: Housing-cartel block. Identities: O_annual = U * R * delta_rent; O_4yr = O_annual * T_SOL; L_treble = 3 * O_4yr under Clayton Act Section 4.

O_Housing_Annual_Overcharge_USD.description: Annual tenant overcharge U * R * delta_rent (USD).

L_Housing_Treble_Damages_USD.description: Clayton Act Section 4 treble damages on the four-year overcharge (USD).

wage_suppression.description: Wage-suppression block. Identities: O_annual = N_workers * W * delta_wage; O_4yr = O_annual * T_SOL; L_treble = 3 * O_4yr under RICO Section 1964(c) and Clayton Act Section 4.

O_Wage_Annual_Suppression_USD.description: Annual wage suppression N_workers * W * delta_wage (USD).

L_RICO_Clayton_Wage_Treble_USD.description: RICO Section 1964(c) and Clayton Act treble wage damages (USD).

cloud_subpoena_spoliation.description: Cloud-subpoena spoliation block. Identity: Omega == 0 implies P_adverse under FRCP Rule 37(e)(2) equals 1.

Omega_Cloud_Metadata.description: Preserved fraction of subpoenaed cloud metadata; 0.0 denotes total spoliation.

P_Adverse_Inference_Rule37e2.description: Probability of the FRCP Rule 37(e)(2) adverse-inference instruction.

distributed_enforcement.description: Distributed-enforcement block. Identities: P_survival = p_capture^K rounded to 6 decimal places; P_cascade = 1 - P_survival. The cartel must capture all K independent nodes simultaneously to survive.

p_Capture_Single_Regulator.description: Probability that the cartel captures a single regulator.

K_Distributed_Enforcer_Nodes.description: Number of independent distributed enforcement nodes.

P_Cartel_Survival_Distributed.description: Joint-capture survival probability p_capture^K (6 decimal places).

combined_liquidation.description: Combined liquidation identity: L_combined = L_ERISA_Systemic + L_Housing_Treble + L_RICO_Clayton_Wage_Treble.

L_Combined_Cartel_Liquidation_USD.description: Total combined cartel liquidation across all three liability vectors (USD).
